summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #39. Added the solver parity test target (corpus schema/loader, an 11-case embedded fixture snapshot, and a runner asserting exact selections, tie sets, earliest-wins tie-breaks, exclusions, and scores through both WeightedSquaredErrorScorer and the full CompositionSolver), plus /api/v1 contract-pinning tests for the future generated-OpenAPI-client migration and red tests that fail until the upstream parity corpus (viamin/color_matching#111) and OpenAPI document (viamin/color_matching#110) are vendored. Fixture arithmetic verified by an independent IEEE-754 double simulation (11/11 cases). swift test could NOT be executed: this container has no Swift toolchain (bin/lint self-reports and skips). Implementation (Package.swift deps, generated client, vendored corpus/spec, README section) is intentionally deferred to the implementation run per phase rules.
